data.act: provision of a benefice sine cura in the monastery of Saint Leodegar
data.object: beneficium ecclesiasticum sine cura in monasterio sancti Leodegarii Vallis
data.regest_de: Felix V. Provisions of a benefice sine cura in the monastery of Saint Leodegar in the Valais for Master Bartholomew de Vivischotensi, a cleric of the diocese of Utrecht, with a value not exceeding 18 marks of silver.
